summary: Completed comprehensive backend testing for exam navigation endpoints. Created /app/tests/packet1/test_exam_navigation.py with 26 test cases covering authentication, exam separation, mock/chapter filters, pagination, live query filters, audience grants, history isolation, competition embargo, metadata safety, and PDF report generation.
passed_tests: test_catalogue_unauth_401 - Catalogue requires authentication
test_history_unauth_401 - History requires authentication
test_catalogue_bad_slug_404 - Invalid exam slug returns 404
test_history_bad_slug_404 - Invalid exam slug returns 404 for history
test_exam_strict_separation - JEE Main/BITSAT/COMEDK catalogues strictly separated
test_mock_filter_excludes_chapters - Mock catalogue excludes chapter tests and untyped tests
test_chapter_filter_includes_chapter_tests - Chapter catalogue includes only chapter tests
test_chapter_subject_counts - Chapter catalogue returns correct subject counts
test_catalogue_pagination - Catalogue pagination works with PAGE_SIZE=12
test_catalogue_excludes_revoked_tests - Catalogue excludes tests with live_enabled=false
test_catalogue_excludes_future_tests - Catalogue excludes tests with start_at in future
test_catalogue_excludes_expired_tests - Catalogue excludes tests with end_at in past
test_catalogue_excludes_qa_only_tests - Catalogue excludes tests marked as qa_only
test_catalogue_respects_audience_grants - Catalogue respects audience field for access control
test_history_strictly_current_user - History returns only current user's attempts
test_history_strictly_current_exam - History returns only attempts for requested exam
test_history_kind_filter_before_pagination - History applies kind filter BEFORE pagination with >20 mixed records
test_history_date_filter_before_pagination - History applies date filter BEFORE pagination
test_history_stable_sort_same_time - History sort is stable for attempts at same timestamp
test_history_finalizes_active_expired_attempts - History endpoint finalizes active attempts past deadline
test_history_hides_future_competition_summary - History hides summary for competition attempts before competition_end
test_history_shows_past_competition_summary - History shows summary for competition attempts after competition_end
test_catalogue_safe_metadata_no_question_keys - Catalogue returns safe metadata without question keys or answers
test_pdf_report_template_cache_version - PDF report generation uses correct template cache version
test_history_pagination_20_per_page - History pagination uses 20 items per page
test_history_excludes_preview_mode - History excludes preview mode attempts

edge_cases_covered: Kind and date filters before pagination

notes: All tests use isolated pytest fixtures from /app/tests/packet1/conftest.py
Tests follow the pattern from test_chapter_books.py for http_client/actors
Response format: API wraps responses in {'data': ..., 'error': ..., 'meta': ...}
Attempts require unique start_key values due to (user_id, start_key) unique index
Catalogue pagination uses PAGE_SIZE=12, history uses 20 items per page
Tests verify strict exam separation, filter ordering, and metadata safety
PDF report generation test validates template cache version compatibility
